18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol palette and monospace count badges show real design care, but the bottom ~40% of the viewport is empty wasted space and collapsed Phylum nodes (pink-filled) are visually indistinguishable from search-match highlights at a glance.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Honest hierarchical encoding: categorical color by rank, binary circle size (parent vs leaf), data-driven layout extent via d3.extent, and correct descendant count labels — no quantitative size deception, no baseline violations, though the node key (name+depth string concat) is slightly fragile.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() calls before new transitions — rapid node clicks or expand/collapse button presses during a 400–500ms flight can cause positional snapping; search is properly debounced, pointer events unify mouse/touch, and no zoom/brush scales exist to go stale.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure with count badges manages 200 nodes cleanly; 6-color rank legend is within limits and the collapsed initial state keeps the view uncluttered, though animation quality on expand/collapse cannot be assessed from the static screenshot.
